findings.text: The reproduction paragraph states the pre-fix tracer's own per-edge tally as [1, 1, 0, 2] against a cell_crossing_count of 2, but those two numbers cannot both come from the tracer: with the parent revision's traced_spline_contour swapped in it reads cell_crossing_count 2 with tally [1, 1, 0, 0], and [1, 1, 0, 2] is the dense scan's true count that the fixed tracer goes on to reproduce at :474, so a reader who re-derives the defect from the sentence is handed a tally that sums to twice its own stated count. The same sentence is carried in docs/plans/forward-solve-api.html:318.

The merge commit 9baca163 body says the panel reference is drawn as assembled branches rather than a scan-order crossing list, but the reference set is exactly what is drawn unconnected here - _branch_style_note returns unassembled, crossings drawn unconnected for it, and the SVG carries 140 blue plus marks per panel with no blue polyline - so the merge record tells a reader the opposite of what the panel shows.

The tracked per-state terms table beside the regenerated figure still records the pre-fix verdict at exactly the four repaired states (edits 9 to 12: closed_candidate_count 0, well_formed false, closed_segment_count 0) and was not regenerated by the fix, while docs/evidence/archive/forward-solve-api-landed.html:472 claims 0 of 20 failing without saying the table is the defect's own record, so the figure directory holds two records that contradict each other at those four states.

justifications.durability: tests/test_flux_surface_connectivity.py:852 pins states 9 to 12 at the terms the bracket produces and :906 adds a displaced-level control, and the fence bites first-hand - with the parent revision's tracer swapped in through the same public entry points those four states read well_formed False with closed_segment_count 0, so the test fails on the pre-fix code.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_flux_surface_connectivity.py:877 drives boundary_flux_at_admitted_saddle and assemble_separatrix_branches and my re-run of the gate gave 34 passed in 94.58 s exit 0, with the census at 0 of 20 (merged) and 4 of 20 at states 9 to 12 (parent) and the state-9 level -0.08161422495624172, cell (5,9) counting four crossings with its left-edge pair 19.364 mm apart at radius 0.605625 m - all recorded in docs/evidence/archive/forward-solve-api-landed.html:466-480, except that the reproduction paragraph at :468 attributes to the tracer a tally the tracer never produced.
justifications.fit: names and comments state the mechanism rather than a plan (derivative_nodes, quadratic_term, break_low, piece_low at nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:1491-1532; _branch_style_note and _null_ordering at benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:1512 and :1525), with no version suffix, deliverable id or ticket reference anywhere in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:1491-1568 replaces the fixed five-sample edge subdivision with a bracket from the edge cubic's own stationary points (three pieces per edge, padded pieces carrying an exact-zero parameter through the slot mask at :1592-1594, EDGE_CROSSING_CAPACITY at :685 honoured), and my own census through the public entry points reproduces 0 of 20 failing against 4 of 20 under the parent revision's tracer.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path the diff touches (nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py, benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py, tests/test_flux_surface_connectivity.py, docs/plans/forward-solve-api.html, docs/evidence/archive/forward-solve-api-landed.html and the converged-vs-nonconverged figure pair) sits inside the declared write paths of the node manifest, and no file outside them changed.
